BMLD.description: Beam Loads (BMLD). A single object keyed by element number whose ITEMS array holds one or more beam-load definitions; each item's CMD (element type), TYPE (load type) and DIRECTION drive which of the vector/eccentricity/distance fields apply.

ITEMS.description: Array of beam-load definitions applied to the element key. Each item is a distinct load; ID distinguishes multiple loads on the same element.

ID.description: Serial number that distinguishes multiple loads on the same element key. Combined with the element key to form the storage union key.

LCNAME.description: Static load case name. Must match an existing static load case (validated at runtime).

GROUP_NAME.description: Load group name. Empty string means no group; a non-empty name must match an existing load group (validated at runtime).

CMD.description: Element type / load classification. BEAM = element beam load, LINE = line beam load, TYPICAL = typical beam load, FLOOR = floor load. Case-insensitive.

TYPE.description: Load type. CONLOAD = concentrated force, CONMOMENT = concentrated moment/torsion, UNILOAD = uniform/trapezoidal load, UNIMOMENT = uniform/trapezoidal moment/torsion, PRESSURE = pressure load. Case-insensitive; validity is hard-enforced.

DIRECTION.description: Load direction. LX/LY/LZ = element local axes, GX/GY/GZ = global axes, VECTOR = user-defined vector (then VX/VY/VZ are used). Case-insensitive; validity is hard-enforced unless VECTOR.

VX.description: [DIRECTION=VECTOR] X component of the user-defined load direction vector. Used only when DIRECTION is VECTOR.

VY.description: [DIRECTION=VECTOR] Y component of the user-defined load direction vector. Used only when DIRECTION is VECTOR.

VZ.description: [DIRECTION=VECTOR] Z component of the user-defined load direction vector. Used only when DIRECTION is VECTOR.

USE_PROJECTION.description: Whether the load is applied as a projected load.

USE_ECCEN.description: Whether eccentricity is used. When true, ECCEN_TYPE, ECCEN_DIR, I_END, J_END and USE_J_END are applied.

ECCEN_DIR.description: [USE_ECCEN=true] Eccentricity direction (same direction enum as DIRECTION). Case-insensitive; validity is hard-enforced when USE_ECCEN is true.

USE_J_END.description: [USE_ECCEN=true] Whether the J-end eccentricity distance is used.

D.description: Distance ratios/positions of the load points [x1, x2, x3, x4]. Only the first 4 values are stored; fewer values are zero-padded to 4.

P.description: Load values at the corresponding D points [v1, v2, v3, v4]. Only the first 4 values are stored; fewer values are zero-padded to 4.

USE_ADDITIONAL.description: Whether an additional H-from-top load region is used.

USE_ADDITIONAL_J_END.description: Whether the additional-region J-end distance is used.
